one_liner: systeme.io has a REST public API authenticated with a self-generated X-API-Key, plus an official hosted MCP server (mcp.systeme.io) using MCP keys, available on all plans including Free.
auth_notes: The official docs say the API key in the X-API-Key header is the only option. The MCP server uses an MCP key via X-MCP-Key header or mcpKey query parameter. Keys are created in account settings, with optional expiry.
access_notes: Keys are generated in the dashboard under Settings > MCP & API keys. The vendor says the MCP server is included in all plans including Free. The pages do not state the plan requirement for the REST API itself, but it shares the same key settings page, so a free account likely suffices.
blocker_notes: Per-user API keys are required rather than OAuth; this is not a blocker. Free-plan REST API access is not explicitly stated, but MCP is stated as available on the Free plan.
